items.q: building, and then a little room. I think the floor plan -- say like a 9 by 12 rug, you get in there. There's Teddy Wilson, Chittison, Herman Chittison, just all of the piano players waiting for Art.

ctx.x: Or whoever was there. What was this guy's name? Marlowe Morris. Was a great stride piano player. So we would go up here between shows, and we'd have the chauffeur to drive us back down to finish. After that he would -- we would go to another place -- when we finished work rather we would go to another club called Rubens. Now, you understand that I was always with him. Okay. We would go to Rubins.

Now, this is a place we -- you go in the building and you go down a flight of stairs to the basement, and you go through a tunnel to another building, and then a little room. I think the floor plan -- say like a 9 by 12 rug, you get in there. There's Teddy Wilson, Chittison, Herman Chittison, just all of the piano players waiting for Art.
